redesign_directions.task: Replace the main decision loop with a two-phase approach: (1) generate an initial valid sequence using the existing fastPolicy/greedy rollout; (2) perform iterative local search on the sequence, mutating by swapping adjacent actions, moving an action to an earlier turn, or changing an action to another (i,j) or -1, accepting mutations that increase the exact final apple count while maintaining validity. Use the full time budget for as many mutations as possible.
redesign_directions.hypothesis: The online one-step lookahead commits to each action based on a greedy rollout, which can be myopic and fail to reorder investments to exploit compounding. Offline local search on the entire 500-turn action sequence can discover non-greedy orderings (e.g., upgrading higher levels earlier) that yield higher final apples.
